title: Live map of public transport in Belgium
summary: A live interactive map website displaying real-time public transportation routes and schedules across Belgium, including trains, buses, trams, and metro systems, allowing users to track and plan their transit journeys.
problem_solved: Provides real-time visibility and tracking of public transportation options across Belgium.
why_valuable: Helps commuters and travelers easily discover and monitor public transit options with up-to-date information in one convenient interface.
